meta.title: Buyer-Side Vendor Profile Editing: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Open vendor management and edit an existing vendor profile as a buyer, verify the capability is refused or absent on a below-Growth tenant, then repeat and verify it is available on a Growth tenant; the catalog cannot inspect plan tiers or vendor profile editing.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open vendor management and edit an existing vendor profile as a buyer, verify the capability is refused or absent on a below-Growth tenant, then repeat and verify it is available on a Growth tenant; the catalog cannot inspect plan tiers or vendor profile editing.

args.need: sign in as the same buyer on a below-Growth tenant and a Growth tenant, open vendor management, attempt to edit an existing vendor profile on both tenants, and report whether the editor is absent or refused below Growth and available on Growth

steps.note: The catalog has no step for vendor management, vendor profile editing, plan verification, or switching to the tenants needed for this comparison.
